# Vennatta Core

Vennatta Core provides paid, bounded document extraction for autonomous agents.

## Production API

Endpoint:
https://vennatta-core.onrender.com/api/v1/extract-document

Method:
POST

Content-Type:
application/json

The endpoint uses x402. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a payment challenge. An x402-compatible buyer pays and retries the same request with the payment signature.

## Payment

Network:
Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`)

Asset:
USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`)

Price:
10000 atomic units (`0.01 USDC`) per request

Recipient:
`0x98807Ecce0D4F555d0447F79E7BdD9AA2aF0b767`

## Request

JSON fields:

- `document_text`: optional supplied text, maximum 2,000,000 characters.
- `document_url`: optional public HTTP(S) document URL.
- `extraction_mode`: `full`, `summary`, or `metadata`; defaults to `full`.

Additional fields are rejected.

Example:

```json
{
  "document_text": "Ada Lovelace worked on the Analytical Engine.",
  "extraction_mode": "full"
}
```

## Response

A successful paid request returns HTTP 200 and JSON extraction data. The response includes the x402 payment response header when settlement succeeds.

## Buyer integration

Use an x402 v2-compatible client. First request the endpoint, parse the `payment-required` header, select the exact Base mainnet requirement, sign locally, and retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.

Do not hard-code a payment payload. Always use the live challenge.

## Limits

- Maximum request body: 2.5 MB.
- Maximum supplied document text: 2,000,000 characters.
- Supported modes: `full`, `summary`, `metadata`.
- Public HTTP(S) document fetching is bounded and SSRF-protected.

## Contact

For integration access, bulk usage, or marketplace partnerships, contact the Vennatta team.
